edinburgh_castle.name: Edinburgh Castle
edinburgh_castle.price_text: ≈ £19.50 adult · under 16 cheaper · book online for a small discount
edinburgh_castle.hours: Daily, roughly 09:30–18:00 in summer and to 17:00 in winter · check on the day
edinburgh_castle.tip: Arrive at opening or after 15:00 to dodge the worst crowds. The One O'Clock Gun fires on weekdays.
edinburgh_castle.best: Morning or late afternoon; avoid midday in summer

royal_mile.name: Royal Mile
royal_mile.hours: Always open · shops and pubs roughly 10:00–late
royal_mile.tip: Walk downhill from the Castle to Holyrood. Duck into the closes (narrow side alleys) for quiet courtyards.
royal_mile.best: Early morning before the crowds, or evening

holyroodhouse.name: Palace of Holyroodhouse
holyroodhouse.price_text: ≈ £18 adult · cheaper for students and seniors · check current price
holyroodhouse.hours: Closed some days for royal use · usually Thu–Mon 09:30–18:00 in summer · check on the day
holyroodhouse.tip: The audio guide is included and worth it. The ruined abbey next door is free.

calton_hill.name: Calton Hill
calton_hill.tip: Short climb from the east end of Princes Street. Go at sunset for the best skyline view.

forth_bridge.name: Forth Bridge
forth_bridge.price_text: Free to view · boat trips and bridge walks cost extra
forth_bridge.tip: Best seen from South Queensferry or a train to North Queensferry. Allow half a day for the trip out.

fringe.name: Edinburgh Festival Fringe
fringe.price_text: Many free shows · ticketed shows roughly £10–25
fringe.hours: Runs for about three weeks each August
fringe.tip: Book big names early, but leave room for free shows and the street performers on the Royal Mile.

edinburgh_zoo.name: Edinburgh Zoo
edinburgh_zoo.price_text: ≈ £22 adult · book online for a lower price
edinburgh_zoo.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–17:00 · later in summer · check on the day
edinburgh_zoo.tip: Home of the penguins and the famous penguin parade. It is on a hill, so wear good shoes.

haggis.name: Haggis (a dish to try)
haggis.price_text: ≈ £12–18 for a pub plate of haggis, neeps and tatties
haggis.hours: Served at most pubs from lunch to late
haggis.tip: Try it once in a pub with neeps and tatties. Vegetarian haggis is widely available.

ladies_waldegrave.name: The Ladies Waldegrave
ladies_waldegrave.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–17:00 · check on the day
ladies_waldegrave.tip: This Reynolds painting hangs in the Scottish National Gallery. Combine it with the free collection next door.

university_edinburgh.name: University of Edinburgh
university_edinburgh.price_text: Free to walk the Old College quad
university_edinburgh.tip: Peek into the Old College quad off South Bridge. The area around George Square is the main campus.

grassmarket.name: Grassmarket
grassmarket.hours: Pubs and restaurants from late morning to late
grassmarket.tip: Good cluster of pubs under the Castle. Sit outside on a sunny evening.

dean_village.name: Dean Village walk
dean_village.tip: Walk from Dean Village along the Water of Leith to Stockbridge. Quiet, green and photogenic.

arthurs_seat.name: Arthur's Seat
arthurs_seat.tip: The main path from Holyrood takes about 45 minutes up. Wear shoes with grip and check the weather.
arthurs_seat.best: Clear morning or sunset; avoid high wind

water_of_leith.name: Water of Leith Walkway
water_of_leith.tip: A flat riverside path through the city. Good for a quiet half-day away from crowds.

leith_walk.name: Leith Shore walk
leith_walk.hours: Always open · restaurants from lunch to late
leith_walk.tip: Walk the Shore and the Water of Leith mouth, then eat. Buses and trams connect back to the centre.

scott_monument.name: Scott Monument
scott_monument.price_text: ≈ £8 adult to climb · check current price
scott_monument.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–17:00 · check on the day
scott_monument.tip: Narrow spiral stairs with 287 steps. The view over Princes Street is worth the climb.

national_museum.name: National Museum of Scotland
national_museum.tip: Free, dry and great with kids. The rooftop terrace has a good view.

stockbridge_market.name: Stockbridge area and market
stockbridge_market.hours: Sunday market usually mornings · check on the day
stockbridge_market.tip: Sunday is market day. The surrounding streets have good cafés and delis.

underground_tour.name: Underground vaults tour
underground_tour.hours: Tours run through the day and evening · book ahead
underground_tour.tip: Ghost-tour style walks are fun but theatrical. Pick one with good reviews and dress warm.

princes_street.name: Princes Street Gardens
princes_street.tip: Sit below the Castle for the classic photo. In winter the Christmas market takes over.
